text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've made it. The Yasuda Kinen is
today.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
And she's planning to run in the
Takarazuka Kinen
in a few weeks too,
right?! This is unprecedented!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
She's on the Triple Tiara tour, and she
has a fairly
small frame to begin with...
This is going to be
one tough month for
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Yasuda Kinen is another race that
very few
Triple Tiara Umamusume have
ever won.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You know... I think she can pull this off...
I mean,
this is Sweep Tosho we're talking
about here.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: She's gonna show us all some magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. That's right! You guys are
starting to get
it too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win the Yasuda Kinen! And
then...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make my incantation even
stronger and
use it to thrash the hero!
